records.text: A Breitbart executive told Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk that Ben Shapiro started The Daily Wire through a manufactured scandal.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep zSKrxIUMNqw)

appearances.snippet: And a chief shared with us the true story of how Ben (Ben Shapiro) started the Daily Wire on scandal.

verification.notes: The source is an unnamed former Breitbart executive speaking privately; neither the identity nor the manufactured-scandal account can be independently authenticated.

records.text: The Daily Wire was being built quietly by the end of 2015 but lacked the support its founders expected.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep zSKrxIUMNqw)

appearances.snippet: what really happened was that Ben (Ben Shapiro) had been not happy with the fact that they were not making him the king of Breitbart, had begun quietly building Daily Wire at the end of 2015. Like didn't have enough gumption behind it. People were not getting behind the daily wire in the way that they anticipated they needed a scandal.

verification.notes: The Daily Wire's own history confirms it launched in 2015. The claims that it was built quietly by year-end and lacked the support its founders expected rely on a private account and are not independently established.

sources.title: About — The Daily Wire
sources.relevance: The company's official history confirms a 2015 launch and initial investment, but not the private claim about expected support.

records.text: Ben Shapiro and Jamie Weinstein manufactured the Michelle Fields scandal to give The Daily Wire momentum.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep zSKrxIUMNqw)

appearances.snippet: And they decided to do that. They decided to create a scandal because there was no energy behind it. ... And his best friend Jamie Weinstein decided to cook up a scandal.

verification.notes: Police and prosecutorial review found video evidence that Lewandowski grabbed Fields and probable cause for battery. No reliable evidence supports the claim that Shapiro and Weinstein manufactured the incident to launch The Daily Wire.

sources.title: Florida state attorneys explain why they did not prosecute Corey Lewandowski
sources.relevance: Reports that prosecutors found probable cause and video evidence of the grab, contradicting a manufactured-incident premise.

sources.title: Donald Trump's Campaign Manager Charged for Grabbing Reporter
sources.relevance: Documents the police report, video, and bruising; provides no evidence of a Shapiro-Weinstein fabrication.

records.text: we heard it straight from the chief at Breitbart.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: we heard it straight from the chief at Breitbart.
